analysis.origin: derived after download from verified original ZIP members
analysis.checks: Revalidated both raw JSONL files with the reviewed validator; verified complete source snapshots, overlay, lock, SDK and per-suite counts.

conclusion: The original product reproduces the unresolved navigation Future in all four Legacy/Smart and matrix/page cases; the candidate preserves destination and completes all eleven navigation/lifecycle regressions plus existing selected viewer/layout tests.
limitations: Correctness tests with controlled widget fixtures, not application performance or native PDF corpus measurements.
The geometry-change fix finishes the active animation at its requested destination before remapping; it does not preserve the original animation duration.
Other operating-system lanes and the native MG374 application diagnostic are separate evidence and are not implied by this result.
